label: late original-phase step, many a/v/c/u/j/0/w/n/1/i/m tokens already seen, current input not in that set
explanation: Accumulator-like unit active almost only in the original (input) phase (98% of mass), never at t<=2 or in the copy phase, with a small tail at the <DEL> step. Rate rises steeply with position (orig_idx 5: 18%, 8: 60%) and with L. On top of position, it is boosted by how many tokens from a group Q={a,v,c,u,j,0,w,n,1,i,m} have appeared earlier (first_tok in Q gives ~2x lift), and is suppressed when the current input is itself in Q; current inputs l,3,r,g,2,x,h are favored. Predicate t + n_seen(Q) >= 8 with in_tok not in Q gives dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.82; a weighted version adding a bonus for in_tok in {l,3,r,g,2,x,h} reaches F1 0.72. Top activations (near max) are at the last original steps of long sequences dominated by Q tokens. It behaves as a graded linear score over position and token history rather than a crisp condition, so precision/recall remain incomplete.
